title: Supreme_Backdoor_Factory_Incident_Response_Scenario_09c
description: Investigate and respond to a potential compromise involving a backdoor on the target host.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The organization has detected unusual network activity originating from the target host. Initial analysis suggests a potential compromise involving a backdoor. Your task is to investigate and respond to this incident.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the target host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the target host with the following credentials:

- Password: cyrano

levels.title: Investigate Unusual Network Activity
levels.content: While monitoring network traffic, you noticed unusual outbound connections from the target host. Your task is to identify the source of this activity.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or unauthorized services. The hidden flag is the name of the suspicious service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or unauthorized services.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: You have identified a suspicious service running on the target host. Your next step is to understand how this service maintains persistence across reboots.
levels.solution: Investigate the systemd timers and services to find the persistence mechanism. The hidden flag is the name of the systemd timer responsible for the service's persistence.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the systemd timers and services to find the persistence mechanism.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious File
levels.content: Now that you have identified the suspicious service and its persistence mechanism, locate the executable or file associated with this activity.
levels.solution: Check the service unit file for the ExecStart path. The hidden flag is the path to the suspicious file.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the service unit file for the ExecStart path.
